# ほりほり工場 / Dig Factory Tycoon

> A free browser game (no install) where you dig down with drills, carry resources up with conveyors, process them in machines and sell them by truck. Vertical mining + factory building + management simulation with idle progress. Works on phones and PCs. Languages: English, Japanese (kanji) and a simple hiragana mode for kids. Made by Kinomeno (キノメノ).
> ドリルで地面を掘り、コンベアで運び、機械で加工して、トラックで売る。縦に掘り進む、無料のブラウザ採掘・工場経営ゲーム（インストール不要・スマホ／PC）。ひらがな・漢字・英語に対応。作者：キノメノ。

## Play
- [Play the game](https://horihori.kinomeno.com/): opens in the browser, free
